chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
There is no harm in salat (prayer) while you are looking at images if they have only one eye.

key_terms.بِالصَّلَاةِ: in salat (prayer), the ritual act of worship
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm or objection

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to perform salat (prayer) while looking at images?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning salat (prayer) in the presence of images. It indicates that praying while facing or looking at images is not objectionable in the specific case that the images are one-eyed, showing a qualification in the ruling related to visual forms during worship.
